title: Link field - cannot link to other DocType

posts.cooked:

I’ve created a custom DocType in a new custom Module. If I try to add a new Field to the DocType of type “Link”, I get an error message (please see below). I tried to link to DocType “Sales Invoice”. I also tried to link to other DocTypes, none of them is working.

Anyboday an idea?

Sorry, I’m new to ERPnext.

regards,
Robert
